newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola falls on commercials, stop loss selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola falls on commercials, stop loss selling.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commercial and commission selling, traders said.

"There was commission selling across the board. Commercials sold the spreads," a trader said. Commission houses sold November put options, bought January and March calls from LFG. Nov-Jan spread at $4.50, Mar-May $0.50, Jan-May $0.50, May July at $2.50, Nov-Mar $5, Nov-May $6.50.
Japan bought 2,000 tonnes of canola, sources said.
November canola fell $6.30 to $400.20, January lost $4.60 to $405.90. Volume was 12,050 lots with 200 hedges. May, July and August set new lows.
November flax lost $2.70 to $366. Volume was 583 lots with 50 hedges. Oats did not trade.
November barley fell $0.60 to $144.90 on Alberta Wheat Pool sales. Nov-Feb spread at $2.50, Nov-Mar $2.70, Feb-Mar $0.50. Volume was 1,800 lots.
October feed wheat rose $1.30 to $178, March lost $0.90 to $167.80 as Midland Walwyn sold 200 contracts. Oct-Dec spread at $7, Dec-Mar $1.50. Volume was 1,065 lots.
UGG sold 25 February feed peas down US$3 at US$200.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas, oats).
